name: Chop A Forest
desc:
Welcome to Chop a Forest! 🪓

You're offered a LARGE sum of MONEY to cut down all the trees in a forest, will you do it? 🤨

Break Trees to Collect logs 🪵
Sell the logs to earn Coins 🪙
Use the coins to buy tools 🪚
Upgrade your tools 📈
Get the BEST Classes and Tools 🏆
